justified_shrinks.reason: The 2026-09-01 dentistry citation run asked for the phrase "Use the same questions with every lawyer on your shortlist" to be removed. It was the title and a table cell of one compiled cost_table artifact, so the artifact is withheld from recovery rather than re-titled - this route has no current semantic-manifest entry to recompile it from. The removal is what the report asked for; every other artifact on the page is intact. See data/release/withheld_page_phrases.json.

Fifteen bytes RELOCATED, not lost. The 2026-08-17 personal-injury run named its target as "personal-injury/index.html • INTENT: informational (awareness) • DECISION: repair_existing". Until the resolver learned to strip the bullet-separated instruction tail, that whole string was unparseable and the row fuzzy-matched onto this insight, which the agent never named. Its repair marker and the sentence carrying it therefore rendered here. With the shape parsed, the row resolves to personal-injury/index.html - the page the agent wrote down - and the marker moved with it. Every artifact this insight was independently asked for by the 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-10 runs is intact and still ledgered against it.

Leaked markdown syntax removed, not content. The 2026-09-02 TRT run wrote its EDIT text in markdown and the acceptance compiler lifted quoted spans out of it verbatim, so headings and comparison-table cells published the literal ATX hashes - 17 of them on trt/index.html reading "### best TRT clinic near me". asHeadingCopy in scripts/lib/html_fix_acceptance_parser.js now strips leading hashes, list bullets and wrapping emphasis from every string that becomes reader-facing copy. The 276 bytes are those markers. No sentence, row, list item or block was removed: the same artifacts render, with the syntax gone.
